name: motion-runtime-os
description: Executable Motion Runtime OS with provider-neutral IR, Remotion and HyperFrames adapters, audio/subtitles and visual regression gates

scripts.dev: npm run assets:prepare && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run assets:prepare && remotion bundle src/index.ts
scripts.render:intro: npm run assets:prepare && remotion render src/index.ts CinematicIntro out/cinematic-intro.mp4
scripts.render:multi: npm run assets:prepare && remotion render src/index.ts MultiSceneDemo out/multi-scene-demo.mp4
scripts.provider:remotion: npm run assets:prepare && node scripts/run-remotion-provider.mjs CinematicIntro examples/cinematic-intro/motion-ir.json out/cinematic-intro.mp4 out/cinematic-intro.render-result.json
scripts.provider:hyperframes: npm run assets:prepare && node scripts/run-hyperframes-provider.mjs examples/cinematic-intro/motion-ir.json out/hyperframes/cinematic-intro.mp4 out/hyperframes/cinematic-intro.render-result.json
scripts.frames:intro: npm run assets:prepare && node scripts/render-keyframes.mjs CinematicIntro out/cinematic-intro.keyframes.json evidence/frames/current
scripts.qa:run: npm run validate:ir && npm run qa:static && npm run qa:av-sync && npm run provider:conformance && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run qa:run && npm run build
